title: Sergey Brin spends over $100 million to fight wealth tax.
summary: The Google co-founder, and world’s fourth-richest person, has spent $102 million so far to put a stop to the one-time, five percent tax on the wealth of California billionaires, according to filings tallied by Bloomberg .
